run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit across every namespace whose name starts with 'app-283', read as cluster state at query time (2026-11-20T21:24:51Z–21:24:55Z). Four such namespaces exist: app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search (14 namespaces inspected in total). Each contains a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' holding an 'audit_code' key; all four share the data key set audit_code, owner=platform-team, tier=standard, and each has a distinct audit_code: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q, app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V, app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z, app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. All four ConfigMaps report creationTimestamp 2026-11-20T21:24:40Z, roughly 10–15 seconds before the reads, so the reported codes are the values in place at query time and say nothing about earlier values in the window. No fifth app-283 namespace and no 'service-manifest' ConfigMap outside those four namespaces was returned (33 ConfigMaps inspected cluster-wide). No failure question was posed, so no root cause is named; the reads are point-in-time object state, not historical proof.
